Please note that the value of the Underlying is the single-decimal value reported by the BLS.

candidates.rules_secondary: The market will always close at 8:29 AM ET on the scheduled day of the data release (December 10, 2026). candidates.title: Will Headline be Exactly 0.2% AND Core be Exactly 0.2% for Oct 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If ALL of the following occur for Oct 2026: Headline: Exactly 0.2%, Core: Exactly 0.2%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
For all outcomes in this market, Headline refers to the single-decimal month-over-month percent change in CPI-U: All Items, and Core refers to the single-decimal month-over-month percent change in CPI-U: All Items Less Food and Energy.

This is a combination market requiring ALL specified outcomes to occur for the contract to pay out. If ANY single component resolves to No or becomes impossible, the entire contract immediately resolves to No. Each component is resolved according to its corresponding Kalshi ruleset: Headline CPI MoM and Core CPI MoM each use ECONSTAT. For economic data releases, resolution uses the first officially released value (not preliminary or revised estimates unless specified). All conditions must be satisfied within the specified time period.

candidates.title: Will someone be nominated for a member of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors before Jan 1, 2027?
candidates.rules_primary: If any person is nominated to be a member of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027. then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: Official announcements made by the President of a nomination shall satisfy the Payout Criterion, even if they are not yet sent to the Senate.

candidates.title: Will the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U in December 2027 be above 6.0%?
candidates.rules_primary: If the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted, in December 2027 is above 6.0%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The initially reported value for December 2027 will be used. This market concerns the 12-month percentage change for December 2027, not the annual-average percentage change for the specified year.
